# xcelsior_ssh_key (Resource)

An SSH public key on the account. Registered keys are installed in the account's interactive instances, including ones already running (within about 30 seconds). A key can be registered once per account. Both arguments force a new key.

Registering and deleting a key needs the `ssh:write` scope. Checking it on refresh, and importing it, needs `ssh:read`, which Quick Connect keys do not hold: with one, Terraform keeps what it recorded at registration and warns that it cannot check the key.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "xcelsior_ssh_key" "laptop" {
  name       = "laptop"
  public_key = file("~/.ssh/id_ed25519.pub")
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `public_key` (String) OpenSSH public key (`ssh-ed25519 AAAA... comment`).

### Optional

- `name` (String) Label, at most 100 characters. Defaults to `default`.

### Read-Only

- `fingerprint` (String) `SHA256:` fingerprint.
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import xcelsior_ssh_key.laptop <key-id>
```
